name: What You're Actually Paying For in a Lynnwood Line-Item Estimate
title-tag: Reading a Refinishing Estimate in Lynnwood, WA
meta-description: A refinishing estimate taken apart line by line: what’s inside the $3.99/sq ft rate, how the area is measured, and why stairs are priced per tread.
post-summary: March 22, 2027 · A refinishing quote is four things: a service rate, a measured area, a per-tread stair number, and named add-ons. What’s hidden inside the per-square-foot line, how footage gets measured, and a real 1,100 sq ft Lynnwood split-level priced out in full.
